description: This script is a test suite for testing error handling and reference operations in Git. It contains functions to test rejection cases, conflict scenarios, and error conditions related to git update-ref commands and reference management.

methods.name: test_update_rejected
methods.description: Tests that updating references with certain parameters leads to expected errors, such as existing references or prefix conflicts.

methods.name: df_test
methods.description: Tests conflict scenarios involving D/F references, symbolic references, and reference creation/deletion conflicts.
